span.p:
Only "published" events accept registrations
(registerForEvent guard).
Un-published events are hidden from visitors.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
New events always start as draft.
DuplicateEvent clones as draft + private.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
An archived event can be re-published.
Passing the event end date does not archive it.
